topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, here we go again. Another department, another set of faces to memorize, another series of protocols to learn by heart. I suppose it's a fresh start, but it feels more like a continuous loop. Everyone's congratulating me, saying it's a step up, an opportunity. I'm sure they mean well, but it’s hard to feel as excited as they do. I wonder how long it will take to settle in, if I'll ever really fit in. The office seems to stretch endlessly, a sea of desks and screens. I just hope I can find my place in it, or at least a corner where I can catch my breath.
